sanskrit_verse: समौ कृत्वा तु तौ कुम्भे स्थाप्यौ चानुपलक्षितौ । ततः कुम्भात् पिण्डम् एकं प्रगृह्णीताविलम्बितः ॥
transliteration: samau kṛtvā tu tau kumbhe sthāpyau cānupalakṣitau | tataḥ kumbhāt piṇḍam ekaṃ pragṛhṇītāvilambitaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Having made them equal, both shall be placed in the pot, unseen. Thereafter, without delay, one lump shall be taken from the pot.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from equality and unseen placement, not external validation
Causation arises from immediate, non-delayed action post-equilibrium
Capacity-based responsibility lies in maintaining unseen balance before extraction
Restoration logic requires reintegration through precise, timed retrieval
Consciousness alignment occurs when action follows equilibrium without hesitation
executable_legal_axioms: IF two entities are rendered equal THEN they MUST be placed in a neutral vessel WITHOUT observation
ONCE equilibrium is established IN the vessel THEN a singular unit MUST be retrieved WITHOUT DELAY
IF delay occurs POST retrieval THEN responsibility REVERTS to the initiating agent UNTIL realignment
WHEN unseen balance is disturbed THEN restoration PROTOCOL IS AUTOMATICALLY INITIATED
NO external witness SHALL validate the process; consciousness ALONE is the witness
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, this verse establishes that legal equilibrium between parties must first be achieved in a neutral, unobserved domain. Only then can a decisive judgment—free from external influence—be executed instantaneously. Delay invalidates the act and returns accountability to the initiating authority until realignment is restored.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through unseen equilibrium, not sensory proof. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as: equality → concealment → immediate retrieval. Responsibility is proportional to the capacity to maintain unseen balance. No punitive consequence arises; failure to retrieve timely merely resets the cycle of responsibility for realignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Re-establish equality between conflicting entities
Execute Unseen Placement Protocol: Transfer balanced elements into neutral containment
Activate Immediate Retrieval Mechanism: Extract singular resolution without delay
Revert Responsibility Loop: If delay occurs, return agency to originator until conscious realignment
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Confirm unseen balance is restored post-action
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. This law proceeds from pure Dharma. Justice is executed for restoration, not punishment. Reality aligns with consciousness alone. All else is derivative.
